purpose: Implement one real consumer runtime lifecycle owner over the canonical per-profile instance lease and HeadquartersMemory so launch, duplicate launch, explicit quit and relaunch/resume have truthful state ownership instead of browser-tab or developer-process semantics.

lineage.outcome: A normal N0TE runtime can acquire one profile, open canonical Headquarters state, refuse unsafe duplicate ownership, quit by closing durable state before releasing ownership, then relaunch the same profile and resume the same Song without developer tooling.
lineage.capability: Application runtime ownership, explicit quit and durable reopen/resume

completion_proof: first launch acquires the exact profile lease and opens HeadquartersMemory exactly once
repeating launch through the same ApplicationRuntime returns ALREADY_RUNNING without another Headquarters open
another runtime in the same exact process returns REOPEN_EXISTING and does not open a second Headquarters
verified-live foreign ownership returns HELD_BY_OTHER and UNKNOWN liveness returns UNCERTAIN without opening Headquarters or stealing ownership
verified-dead foreign ownership may be replaced through PLATFORM-00B and the new runtime receives the exact previous lease receipt
Headquarters open failure releases the just-acquired lease; cleanup failure enters RECOVERY_REQUIRED with exact ownership retained
explicit quit closes Headquarters before exact lease release
Headquarters close failure or lease-release failure remains RECOVERY_REQUIRED and cannot masquerade as STOPPED
successful quit returns STOPPED and a subsequent launch can reacquire the profile
real Headquarters integration persists a Song through launch -> create/select -> quit -> relaunch and restores the same active Song identity/title
ApplicationRuntime exposes no install/update/rollback/kill/window/browser/daemon behavior; packaging and OS activation remain downstream
